description: Objects created without a frame, or with only w and h, are placed in a free spot: beside the caller's terminal (stacking an agent's answers), else near the view. Where they land depends on the user's viewport, which only the client knows; the sizes and the rest are compared.

ignore.response.result.object.frame.x: placement inside the user's view (client viewport)
ignore.response.result.object.frame.y: placement inside the user's view (client viewport)
ignore.events.*.data.frame.x: placement inside the user's view (client viewport)
ignore.events.*.data.frame.y: placement inside the user's view (client viewport)
